sources.name: SEC Financial Statement Data Sets
sources.coverage: 2009q1-present, quarterly, as filed face-financial XBRL
limitations: historic ZIPs were reprocessed in December 2024 and therefore each retrieved payload must be retained by hash
the local execution network returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-08; acquisition needs a separately verified network path

sources.name: Internet Archive captures of SEC Financial Statement Data Set ZIPs
sources.coverage: 247 distinct captures covering all 69 quarters from 2009q1 through 2026q1
limitations: archive capture time is transport provenance, not a filing acceptance time
older quarter ZIPs were first archived years after the filings; filing-level availability must come from SEC accepted metadata
every replay payload must match its CDX SHA-1 digest and pass the SEC ZIP member contract

sources.name: Internet Archive captures of SEC EDGAR daily feeds, Oldloads and individual submissions
sources.coverage: EDGAR daily-feed, Oldloads and individual Form 25/15 transports, sampled and population-measured for 2009-2024
limitations: daily-feed captures locate 67.46% and Oldloads 60.42% of unique candidate accessions; their exact union locates 89.99%
the union is locator coverage, not proof that every located payload has already been downloaded and content-validated
CDX WARC length is not replay payload length; one 549,886-byte CDX record exposed a 791,328,619-byte replay payload
individual filing captures were found for only 5 of 32 deterministic year/event-class sample accessions
capture time is transport provenance and never substitutes for SEC acceptance time
2,746 accessions, population content completeness, effective dates and delisting returns remain open

sources.name: Common Crawl CDXJ, URL Index and static ZipNum index for SEC filing URLs
sources.coverage: 126 crawl collections listed through CC-MAIN-2026-30; deterministic SEC sample queried in nearest later and latest collection
limitations: the public CDX API was unreachable on the local network and naive remote Parquet scans did not complete within ten minutes
the static ZipNum fallback was reproducible and content-addressed but found zero captures in the fixed 32-accession policy
two collections per accession do not prove absence from all 126 collections
Common Crawl capture presence would still require WARC payload, SEC accession and form validation

sources.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and companyfacts APIs
sources.coverage: filing histories, accessions, current company facts and bulk archives
limitations: current ticker arrays are not a historical listing ledger
exact historic ticker and exchange still require filing-cover or corporate-action evidence
the local execution network returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-08

sources.name: SEC EDGAR daily/full indexes and original submissions
sources.coverage: filing index, original filing headers and Form 25/15 evidence
limitations: the master index has filing date but exact acceptance time must be read from the original submission header
Form 25 proves exchange removal but does not by itself supply a complete return series

sources.name: SEC Market Structure Metrics by Individual Security
sources.coverage: daily ticker-level CRSP/MIDAS stock and ETP universe, 2012q1-present; locally verified without gaps through 2024q4
limitations: the files expose ticker, date, security class, price/size/turnover/volatility ranks and trade-volume metrics, but not raw OHLC prices
SEC methodology states that the stock/ETP list and closing-price inputs come from CRSP with a 3-4 week update lag
ticker-to-CIK linkage still requires filing-cover or other entity evidence
coverage starts in 2012 and therefore does not close the 2009-2011 universe gap
the local SEC endpoint is rate-blocked, but the official ZIPs can be recovered through digest-verified Wayback captures
archive capture time is provenance; retrospectively published MIDAS rows are not contemporaneous signals
the official 2014q2 distribution is a ZIP containing another ZIP and is accepted only after outer and inner CRC plus CDX digest verification

sources.name: SEC filing cover-page XBRL and visible filing cover
sources.coverage: TradingSymbol, SecurityExchangeName and security title in recent Inline XBRL; visible cover before broad Inline XBRL adoption
limitations: pre-Inline-XBRL filings need deterministic cover-page parsing and ambiguity quarantine
multiple securities and secondary listings require separate listing IDs

sources.name: SEC company_tickers and company_tickers_exchange historical snapshots via digest-verified Wayback captures
sources.coverage: 30 selected quarterly company_tickers captures from 2017q3-2024q4 and 11 company_tickers_exchange captures from 2021q3-2024q4
limitations: the SEC states that the association files are periodically updated for search functionality and does not guarantee their accuracy or scope
a Wayback capture proves the official mapping only at its exact capture timestamp and never supplies the actual effective date of a change
direct CIK-ticker coverage begins in 2017 and exchange coverage in 2021; earlier periods still require filing-cover and event reconstruction
missing quarters are never forward-filled and MIDAS ticker presence never establishes CIK or listing continuity

sources.name: Nasdaq Trader Nasdaq-Listed and Other-Listed symbol directories via digest-verified Wayback captures
sources.coverage: 54 exact snapshots recovered for 2009-2024; captures are sparse and not a complete event ledger
limitations: a snapshot proves presence only at its exact capture timestamp and missing quarters are never forward-filled
Wayback coverage is sparse: 12 captures were recovered for 2009-2014 and 42 selected captures for 2015-2024; 38 later quarter/dataset cells have no archived capture
the files contain ticker and security name but no CIK, permanent security ID or delisting return
the 2009 Other-Listed schema used Symbol before the later ACT Symbol field and is parsed as an explicit historical variant

exact and unique normalized issuer-name matching, including contemporaneous EDGAR master-index aliases, generated 112,476 unadjudicated CIK candidates across 227,516 rows; these candidates are deliberately not treated as listing identities

sources.name: Alpha Vantage Listing & Delisting Status Utility
sources.coverage: active/delisted US stocks and ETFs; historical date parameter after 2010-01-01
limitations: the demo key returned only the current active file and rejected historic/delisted calls on 2026-08-08
no configured user key was present and no credential may be invented or exposed
vendor output cannot replace SEC evidence for the primary ledger

sources.name: Massive Stocks Basic
sources.coverage: all US tickers, reference data, corporate actions and two years of history
limitations: two-year free history cannot cover the 2009-2024 confirmatory study
flat files are unadjusted and account access is required

sources.name: Yahoo chart endpoint and existing prices-max store
sources.coverage: long adjusted-close history for many currently resolvable symbols
limitations: known delisted symbols TWTR, ATVI, CERN, XLNX, WORK, FRC, SIVB, LEH and BBBY returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-08
existing prices-max payloads contain adjusted close only, not full OHLCV
current resolution is survivorship biased
the bounded bridge cohort found valid current-ticker files for only 9,095 of 23,165 candidate rows (39.26 percent)
adjusted close may embed corporate-action factors that were unknown at the historical snapshot

sources.name: HF Data Library
sources.coverage: 1,391 US stocks and ETFs, 2002-present minute OHLCV
limitations: not a full US universe
post-2022 data are IEX-only and represent a small fraction of consolidated volume

sources.name: Nasdaq Daily List
sources.coverage: new listings, delistings, symbol/name changes and corporate actions since 1999
limitations: paid source is outside the user's authorization
historic public Daily List distribution was removed in 2004

sources.name: FINRA OTC Equities Daily List and public API
sources.coverage: OTC additions, deletions, symbol/name changes, bankruptcy and corporate actions; historical archive and public API
limitations: the source covers OTC and historical OTCBB securities, not the complete Nasdaq/NYSE listed universe
event availability and API pagination must be independently acquired and hashed before use
corporate-action records do not themselves provide adjusted OHLCV or delisting returns

sources.name: NYSE Regulation Delistings
sources.coverage: current pending exchange- and issuer-initiated delistings
limitations: the public page is a current pending list, not a complete 2009-2024 archive

sources.name: Common Crawl URL index and WARC corpus
sources.coverage: timestamped web captures with WARC payload, crawl digest and byte-range provenance
limitations: capture coverage is incomplete and the public index is rate limited
crawl time proves observation, not original publication
signal eligibility additionally requires an unambiguous exact publication timestamp and a mapped source class

sources.name: Stooq U.S. daily bulk archive
sources.coverage: long-run U.S. daily OHLCV bulk archive
limitations: the direct bulk endpoint returned HTTP 401 on 2026-08-08
the current access path requires a key obtained through an interactive anti-bot flow
delisted-symbol completeness, adjustment policy and corporate-action provenance remain unproven

sources.name: JinJing delisted_unified historical revision
sources.coverage: claimed 1,207,970 delisted OHLCV rows
limitations: payload revision 466227b2149352d28edb6da26871a8c04e5e5894 was independently hashed and inspected
all 1,207,970 rows and all 318 symbols are Chinese-market records; no U.S. delisted symbol is present
the dataset card's generic delisted label is not U.S. coverage

sources.name: Community-republished Finnhub minute OHLCV
sources.coverage: monthly U.S. minute bars claimed for 1992-2026
limitations: the repository declares Finnhub as the original source but provides no dataset license
approximately 87.7 GB and no listing-ID, corporate-action or adjustment provenance
ticker reuse and redistribution rights are unresolved

sources.name: Arandkei Historical Delisted Assets Archive v2
sources.coverage: 20 delisted ticker CSV files in version 2
limitations: only 20 tickers and therefore nowhere near a historical U.S. universe
the README does not identify the primary market-data source
adjusted close falls back to raw close when unavailable and has no action provenance
a filename has reversed start/end dates and the first VIEW row carries literal field names in numeric summary columns
